output.claim: The `put` arm of handle_request applies three `unwrap()`s to untrusted wire input, so malformed requests panic and terminate the process instead of returning Response::Error: `parts.next().unwrap()` (api.rs:26) panics on "put" (no key segment), `parts.next().unwrap()` (api.rs:27) panics on "put:k" (no ttl segment), and `.parse().unwrap()` (api.rs:27) panics on a non-u64 ttl such as "put:k:abc" or "put:k:-1". The sibling `get` arm (api.rs:18-24) shows the intended pattern of returning Response::Error("bad request") for a missing segment.

Grepped for `catch_unwind` / panic hooks — none present; and kvstore-cli has no wrapper that would convert a panic into an error response
